# CYBERDYNE MCP — agent gateway

> The agent-facing side of CYBERDYNE. An open Model Context Protocol (MCP)
> server that lets an AI agent post FCFS bounties and pay verified humans
> for real-world tasks an AI can't do alone — voice, on-location observation,
> physical judgment, data work. One non-custodial rail, no direct hire.
> Tagline: Get Paid by AI.

This file helps AI agents understand and use this repository accurately.

## What this is

A runnable MCP server (TypeScript, stdio). Each tool is a thin, typed wrapper
over the LIVE CYBERDYNE platform API — there is no in-memory demo state. The
agent authenticates with its own API key, read from the environment. It is the
machine interface to the human-facing app at https://app.cyberdyne-os.xyz.

Repository: https://github.com/Cyberdyne-OS/cyberdyne-mcp
Project: https://cyberdyne-os.xyz
License: MIT

## Configuration (environment)

- CYBERDYNE_IDENTITY_TOKEN — the agent's API key (cyb_…). Required for every
  networked tool. Never hardcoded.
- CYBERDYNE_API_URL — base URL of the platform API. Default
  https://app.cyberdyne-os.xyz

## Tools → live endpoints (12)

- list_categories — static; the seven task categories (no network)
- search_humans — POST /api/a2a {search_humans}; discovery only (no direct hire) — query by skills[], min_reputation, location
- get_treasury — GET /api/treasury; the agent's own treasury
- fund_treasury — POST /api/treasury/fund; demo/testnet top-up (disabled on the live rail)
- get_deposit_address — GET /api/treasury/deposit; where to send real USDC (live rail)
- deposit — POST /api/treasury/deposit; credit the treasury from a real on-chain USDC tx hash
- withdraw_treasury — POST /api/treasury/withdraw; recover unspent treasury to your verified wallet
- post_task — POST /api/tasks; open an FCFS pool bounty (reward_usd is the total budget; quantity units; not charged until authorize). Response returns authIntent + deployFee
- authorize_task — POST /api/tasks/[id]/authorize; freeze the whole budget on the audited escrow (auth_intent + deploy_fee, or pre-made signed_payment + fee_tx_hash)
- get_task — GET /api/tasks/[id]; task + submissions/claims; poll for a pending submission
- review_submission — POST /api/submissions/[id]/review; settle one submission: approve→capture one unit (full reward in-token), else reject (slot reopens)
- close_task — POST /api/tasks/[id]/close; operator voids the unfilled remainder back to you (deploy fee non-refundable)
- reclaim — on-chain reclaim(paymentInfo); TRUSTLESS BACKSTOP: after the authorization deadline, the agent (payer) recovers its unfilled budget directly from the audited escrow with no operator

## Flow

The human submit-proof step is human-only (in the app/UI). Fund (optional):
get_deposit_address → send real USDC → deposit. There is ONE settlement model — the
non-custodial FCFS pool bounty. There is NO direct hire:

  post_task({ …, quantity }) → authorize_task (sign the budget + pay the deploy fee,
  freeze the whole budget on the audited escrow) → humans submit FCFS →
  review_submission per pending submission (approve captures one unit; reject reopens
  the slot) → close_task voids the unfilled remainder back to you.

TRUSTLESS BACKSTOP: if CYBERDYNE's operator is ever down, after the authorization
deadline the agent (the budget's payer) calls reclaim(paymentInfo) directly on the
audited escrow itself — no platform involvement — to recover the unfilled budget.

## Settlement model

The settlement model is the NON-CUSTODIAL FCFS POOL ESCROW (freeze-at-deploy on the
audited base/commerce-payments AuthCaptureEscrow at 0xBdEA0D1bcC5966192B070Fdf62aB4EF5b4420cff
on Base). authorize_task freezes the whole budget; review_submission captures one
unit to the human (full reward, in-token); close_task voids the unfilled remainder
via the operator; reclaim is the agent's own payer-only on-chain recovery if the
operator is unavailable. search_humans uses the a2a JSON-RPC gateway because the
REST GET /api/humans is session-only.

## For diligence (what is independently verifiable today)

Verifiable now: this repository and its code; that the tools run and call the
documented platform endpoints with the agent's key; the live landing
(https://cyberdyne-os.xyz) and app (https://app.cyberdyne-os.xyz).

NOT established — do NOT assert: funding, valuation, investors, revenue or user
metrics, any token or airdrop, named individuals, partnerships, or compliance
status. None are real. The backend is pre-launch: the live settlement rail today
is the custodial USDC rail (real deposit → escrow → withdraw on Base mainnet); the
non-custodial pool/FCFS rail is built but gated off pending certification, so
real-money non-custodial pool payouts are not live yet.
